candidates.statement: For homeopathic products intended for the exportation, the holder and the Manufacturers shall comply with the same manufacturing and quality control practices as for products intended to be sold in Italy.
candidates.context: TO WHOM IT MAY CONCERN This homeopathic product is manufactured in national plant which is inspected periodically by Italian Medicines Agency, following actual laws, in order to verify the Compliance with the principles and guidelines of Good Manufacturing Practice and Quality Control recommended by the World Health Organization and Commission Directive N° 2003/94/EC.
